name: bot
pronunciation_note: Owner request 2026-11-04, addressed-only: 'Bot' is one syllable and appears in ordinary speech (chat bot, robot), so only the two-word form is a head. German 'Bott' is /bɔt/, the same short-o word people say for a chat bot, so it is an accepted spelling (owner, 2026-11-04). espeak reads capitalised 'Bot' as the verb 'bot' (/boːt/), which is why the audit first called Boot a homophone; 'Boot' (das Boot, /boːt/) is kept as a near-miss for long-o speakers and is worth a listening check.
